collection.description: A polished fragment washes ashore, bearing markings no villager recognizes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A polished fragment washes ashore, bearing markings no villager recognizes.

choices.label: Study it without guessing its origin.
Warn the village about distant strangers.
Place it in a public collection.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A scholar finds repeating marks but cannot interpret them.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The fragment resists familiar tools, leaving its purpose unknown.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Families prepare supplies, though no stranger appears.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A fearful rumor spreads farther than the evidence warrants.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children imagine marvelous lands beyond the horizon.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder objects that the object may be sacred, and debate continues.
